notes.title: Stick Fight Update Turn World Beta!
notes.content:
[h3]We're doing beta for the next update to make sure it's working well before going live! [/h3]

It's just a little content update for Stick Fight, this game is still a side project that we come back to every now and then. 

[h3]You can access the beta by going into the beta branch:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Right-click the game in your library and pic properties.
[*] Go to the Betas tab 
[*] Enter StickFightBetaTrusted and play the update. 
[/olist]

[h3]Beta Patch Notes: [/h3]
[list]
[*]New world Turn World with 20 new maps! 
[/list]

[h3]Please report any bugs etc in this thread! [/h3]

tags.feature: New world Turn World with 20 new maps!

notes.title: Patch: A bunch of fixes and some small changes!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes

Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed desync preventing the current round from ending if a new player just hotjoined
[*] Fixed key rebindings not working properly in boss mode
[*] Fixed character physics at higher framerates
[*] Fixed game freeze when trying to play only blacklisted maps
[*] Fixed downwards movement input not being ignored while dead or typing
[*] Fixed rare desync where destructibles would sometimes spawn destroyed
[*] Fixed rare desync where snakes would sometimes fail to be assigned a target
[*] Fixed issue where custom map objects would spawn in the wrong location
[*] Fix for desynced snakes spawned from snake-barrels
[*] Fix for playing the game in larger aspect ratios.
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Custom Maps can now be 50% larger than its original size.
[*] When creating custom maps the editor window size is now the same size scale as the playable map will have.
[*] Removed spik and spic from the chat filter
[*] Allowed for uncapped framerate
[*] Skips custom maps set to private during online play
[/list]

A big thank you to Frogsong Studios who have been working on this patch!

Remember to restart steam and verify the integrity of the game-files! 

We cannot answer comments here, please post a thread in the forums or email info@landfall.se

notes.title: Level editor update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30620888/3595f195cfc33ef0061b6c0b4c8388ab554e0c1b.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! We have a huge patch today with level editor stuff and fixes, please let us know if you have any issues.

[b]Tools[/b]
[list]
[*] Pipette tool (keybind "i")
[*] Autosave -  Button to toggle, off, 10min, 5min, 1min
[*] Flip (keybind f) & Rotate (keybind r)
[*] Mirror is now split into Mirror Position & Mirror Rotation
[*] You can now both toggle grid with "x" or turn it on and off with ctrl+"x"
[*] You can now make custom map sizes on custom maps
[*] Drag and drop already placed objects
[*] Rotate and flip already placed objects
[/list]

[b]Props[/b]
[list]
[*] Snake Barrel
[*] Explosive Barrel
[*] Treadmill 
[*] Small Treadmill 
[*] Ice
[*] Small Ice
[*] Hinge Step
[*] Long Crate
[*] Laser Platform
[/list]

[b]
Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Mute button in the editor
[*] Fixed achievement bug happening with snakes in the editor
[*] Fixed bug with crates and some other items sometimes falling out of the custom playfield in an illegal direction
[*] Added information screen with all keybindings for the editor
[*] Added networking to some level editor objects
[*] You can no longer place mirrored objects inside of other objects
[*] Fixed issue with object placement locations being blocked
[*] Black hole no longer sometimes soft locks the game
[*] Black hole can now pull in items in games with less than 4 players
[*] All maps can now be selected using a controller
[*] GUI should now fit better on low-resolution screens
[*] Updated profanity filter
[*] Fixed stats map to appear again when playing locally
[/list]

[b]Please make sure to update the game and verify the integrity of the game-files!

Keep questions and feedback in the forum as we cannot answer here.[/b]

notes.title: Stick Fight patch 1.2.04
notes.content:
Changes: 
[list]
    [*]Increased weight of big crate in the editor.  
    [*]Added automatic AFK kick after 2 minutes when playing online. 
[/list]

Balance:  
[list]
[*]God gun damage has been increased.
[*]Laser AK damage has been reduced. 
[*]Laser AK knockback has been increased. 
[*]Snakes can now be killed with guns.  
[*]Snakes have been made slippier. 
[*]Snakes now add a bit of knockback when dealing damage. 
[*]Snake shotgun now fire 3 snakes instead of 5.
[*]Big snakes gravity increased. They will no longer fly.
[*]Lava spray knockback has been increased.
[*]Lava spray bullet speed has been increased.
[*]Ice gun knock back has been increased.
[*]Ice gun damage has been increased.
[*]Ice gun slow has been increased.
[*]Spear has been made slightly shorter. 
[*]Spear now flies straight when thrown. It no longer spins. 
[*]Uzi knockback increased.
[/list]

Fixes: 
[list]
    [*]Fixed spikes and spike balls being broken on some standard maps.  
    [*]Fixed issue where some explosive weapons would impact big physics objects like the spike ball too much. 
    [*]Hopefully fixed issue where spear would not stay in the right dimension.  
    [*]Optimized explosions.
    [*]Optimized Lasers.
    [*]Fixed issue where game would freeze when getting to the score screen in local play. 
    [*]Fixed the gun waterfall issue. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix patch 1.2.01
notes.content:
Fixes:  
Hopefully fixes issue where a joining player would become invincible and stop a match from ending.  
  
Changes:  
Rebalanced bosses to speed up the boss fights.  
The bosses now have 35% less hp but deal 20% more damage.   
The bosses now scale better with amount of players.

The weapons spawned in the boss levels can now be used against other players when  the boss is not alive.    
Added a color change to these weapons bullets to indicate if they can damage other players.   
  
Changed the timing of the ghost platform to be more forgiving

notes.title: Stick Fight Update 1.0.02
notes.content:
Features:  
Added an option for weapon spawn frequency      
Added chat for online play
  
Fixes:  
Fixed some sounds not being affected by the sound slider.   
Fixed some issues with the new winter levels.    
Fixed an issue when connecting to a full server would take you back to the main menu instead of finding another match.     
Fixed issue where the first game when played online would have broken spawn points.   
Made the end of match slowdown effect more smooth.  
Added a message when someone takes a long time to load a level.   
Hopefully fixed duplicate weapon bug   
Fixed a bug where if someone left during a level transition the other players would freeze    
Fixed bug were part of intro sound would still play after skipping it  
Locked cursor to screen
